name: fixate-bionic
description: FixateBionic: bionic-style reading for Claude Code, bolding the start of each word in replies; tune with /bionic or /config

fixation.title: Fixation
fixation.description: How much of each word is bold: 1 = 20%, 2 = 30%, 3 = 40%, 4 = 50%, 5 = 60%

saccade.title: Saccade
saccade.description: Bold every word (1), every 2nd (2), every 3rd (3) or every 4th (4)

minWordLength.title: Minimum word length
minWordLength.description: Words shorter than this stay plain

headings.title: Apply to headings
headings.description: Also bold word starts inside markdown headings
